commands.command: Implement and run an accepted-only M127 outcome-intervention snippet corpus builder over runs/m126_zero_relvel_m124_strict_60ep_seed9720 runs/m127_zero_relvel_m124_strict_60ep_seed9820 and runs/m127_zero_relvel_m124_strict_60ep_seed9840
commands.name: m128_combined_outcome_snippet_corpus

decision_rule: Before another objective or PPO run, create a combined accepted-only M127 corpus and verify counts/source-side limitations are explicit.
failure_criteria: metadata and npz row counts disagree
source side coverage is hidden or mislabeled
the combined corpus is used for PPO before objective-sanity validation
hypothesis: M127 admits an outcome-centric proof surface across multiple strict zero-relvel runs. A combined accepted-only snippet corpus is needed before testing an outcome-centric objective on that proof surface.
success_criteria: combined npz contains only accepted M127 snippets
combined metadata records source run and source condition
row counts match across npz and csv
next objective-sanity step is defined but PPO is not started
